nodes.label: Stack & Runtime
nodes.rationale: Defines the core technology stack including Next.js 15, TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM.

nodes.label: Monetary & Accounting Rules
nodes.rationale: Mandates the use of decimal.js for all financial calculations to avoid floating-point errors.

nodes.label: Optical Domain & Prescription Rules
nodes.rationale: Specifies discrete eye schema (OD/OS) and dioptric validation logic.

nodes.label: Concurrency & Transaction Safety
nodes.rationale: Requires atomic inventory decrements and database transactions for checkout procedures.
